title: modbus-simulator fixture v1
description: Declarative description of the initial simulated Modbus world. Loaded once at simulator startup. Each device is served on a single TCP listener and routed by unitId.

$schema.description: Advisory JSON Schema URI for editor validation. Never fetched by the CLI; validation uses the embedded schema selected by schemaVersion.

schemaVersion.description: Fixture format version. Must be exactly modbus-simulator.fixture.v1.

description.description: Free-text description of this fixture's purpose (optional).

metadata.description: Arbitrary key/value metadata. The only object that allows additional properties.

defaults.description: Default behavior for all devices. Per-device behavior overrides these values.

devices.description: One or more Modbus devices to simulate. Each device must have a unique unitId in range 1–247.

unknownAddress.description: Policy for reads/writes to addresses not present in the fixture. exception: illegal_data_address for unknown reads and all unknown writes. zeroForReads: reads return 0/false; unknown writes still fail with illegal_data_address.

stateMode.description: Runtime state reset policy. persistent: state survives for the process lifetime. resetOnConnection: writable areas reset to fixture values when a new TCP client connects.

area.description: Modbus memory area name used in exception/fault rule match fields.

supportedFc.description: Supported Modbus function codes for rule matching: 1 read coils, 2 read discrete inputs, 3 read holding registers, 4 read input registers, 5 write single coil, 6 write single register, 15 write multiple coils, 16 write multiple registers, 43 read device identification.

defaults.description: Top-level defaults applied to every device unless overridden in device.behavior.

device.description: One simulated Modbus device identified by unitId on the shared TCP listener.

unitId.description: Modbus unit identifier (1–247). Unit 0 (broadcast) is rejected.

identity.description: FC43/14 device identification objects. When absent, FC43 returns illegal_function.

state.description: Initial values for all four memory areas.

behavior.description: Per-device behavior overrides and optional exception/fault rules.

identity.description: Device identification for FC43. Named fields map to standard objects 0x00 (vendor), 0x01 (product), 0x02 (revision).

objects.description: Additional identity objects (ids 0x80–0xFF). Ids 0x00–0x02 must not appear here.

id.description: Object id (0–255). Reserved ids 0x00–0x02 are set by the named identity fields.

state.description: Initial memory map. Omitted areas are empty.

coils.description: Coils (FC01 read, FC05/FC15 write). Default writable: true.

holdingRegisters.description: Holding registers (FC03 read, FC06/FC16 write). Default writable: true.

booleanPointWritable.description: One coil point with optional writable flag.

writable.description: Whether FC05/FC15 may write this address. Defaults to true when omitted.

booleanPointReadonly.description: One discrete input point (read-only; writable is forbidden by schema).

registerPointWritable.description: One holding register with optional writable flag.

writable.description: Whether FC06/FC16 may write this address. Defaults to true when omitted.

registerPointReadonly.description: One input register (read-only; writable is forbidden by schema).

behavior.description: Per-device runtime behavior. Overrides fixture.defaults. exceptions and faults are evaluated before built-in validation.

exceptions.description: Deterministic Modbus exception rules (first match wins).

faults.description: Transport/runtime fault rules (first match wins; lower priority than exceptions).

match.description: Rule match criteria. All present fields must match. address and addressRange are mutually exclusive.

address.description: Match when the request covers this address.

addressRange.description: Match when any requested address falls in [start, end].

quantity.description: Exact match on request quantity when present.

addressRange.description: Inclusive address range for rule matching. Requires start <= end.

exceptionRule.description: Return a Modbus exception when match succeeds. Recorded in trace matchedRule.

id.description: Optional rule id echoed as trace matchedRule. Defaults to exception[index] when omitted.

faultRule.description: Simulate a transport fault when match succeeds. delay still completes with ok:true; timeout and connectionClose record ok:false.

id.description: Optional rule id echoed as trace matchedRule.

fault.description: delay: wait delayMs then serve normally. timeout/connectionClose: failure recorded in trace.

delayMs.description: Wait time in milliseconds before the fault outcome (optional for connectionClose).
